threshold_criterion: maximise F1 on OOF (better than accuracy for imbalanced data)
note: All data fall in 2026 (weeks 1-22). This is a cross-sectional outbreak-status model per unit-week, NOT a multi-year temporal forecast (no year-to-year lag available). Class weights (scale_pos_weight) are applied to address severe class imbalance (~7% outbreak cells).
